French Education Minister: 'We should have questioned earlier what measures to take for middle school'
subhead: While the results from the OECD survey show that French students are falling behind, the French education minister talks of a 'deep-seated phenomenon,' namely a shift in how children are educated, with heavy exposure to social media. title: Despite anti-immigration rhetoric, Sweden's public services still rely on foreign workers
subhead: While all major parties are promoting restrictive immigration policies and limits on the arrival of refugees ahead of the September 13 elections, municipalities and regions have never relied more heavily on people born abroad to fill gaps in the workforce.

title: French far right wants to cut aid to Ukraine. It represents a drop in the ocean of public finances
subhead: Several senior members of the far-right Rassemblement National have cited budgetary discipline to try and justify their proposal to cut financial aid to Ukraine, should Marine Le Pen win next year's presidential election.

title: Bishop Etienne Guillet of Saint-Denis, a bridge-builder in the banlieues
subhead: In Seine-Saint-Denis, an underprivileged area of the Paris region where Catholics are a minority, France's youngest bishop is working to strengthen ties between religions. He is preparing for the pope's visit in a spirit of openness.

title: In this French city, social diversity in schools has almost disappeared
subhead: According to studies, the southern city of Perpignan is the most educationally segregated in France. It's divided between private schools, which rank among the most privileged in the country, and public schools, which, in almost every case, sit at the exact opposite end of the social scale.

title: In Los Angeles, thousands of Americans are forced to live in their cars
subhead: Several thousand people live in a car, van or camper in the city of Los Angeles. The situation highlights the growing difficulties of low-income Americans to find stable housing, a major problem in the United States.
